title: Ignite the Night
lyrics: Feel the pressure in your veins
Summer running through the flames
Every shadow disappears
As the atmosphere clears
Ignite the night, let it burn
This is the point of no return
Higher now, we rise as one
Chasing the midnight sun
City trembling at our feet
Every heartbeat skips a beat
When the dark begins to fall
We become the light for all
Ignite the night, let it burn
This is the point of no return
Higher now, we rise as one
Chasing the midnight sun
When the sky turns gold to black
We don’t ever look back
We are the spark, the spark
Lighting up the dark
Ignite the night, let it burn
This is the point of no return
Higher now, we rise as one
Chasing the midnight sun
